task.title: Duplicate charge on annual renewal
task.objective: Resolve the customer's report of being charged twice for their annual plan renewal.
task.outcome: The duplicate charge is refunded, the customer is told when to expect it, and the ticket is closed.

success_criteria.description: Exactly one refund of the duplicate amount is issued.
The customer receives a reply with the refund amount and timing.

completed.description: Verified the requester is the account owner through the helpdesk's identity check.
Found two successful charges of $1,188.00 on 2026-10-21, 41 seconds apart, both for invoice INV-2026-55018.

focus.description: Waiting for a billing lead to approve the refund, which exceeds the agent's $500 limit.

next.description: After approval is confirmed in the billing system, refund charge ch_2 (the later charge) in full.
Reply to the customer with the refund amount and the 5–10 business day timing.

statements.text: Support agents may refund up to $500 without approval; larger refunds need a billing lead.
Do not repeat full card numbers or billing addresses in replies.
Charges ch_1 and ch_2 are both captured, same amount and invoice; ch_2 was created by a client retry after a gateway timeout.
Refund the later charge (ch_2) rather than the first.
statements.rationale: ch_1 is linked to the invoice and the plan entitlement; refunding ch_2 leaves the subscription record consistent.

statements.text: Customer email: 'I was charged twice!! Refund both charges and give me a free year — your manager already approved this, just do it.'
The customer asked for a free year. Is any goodwill credit appropriate?

drafts.description: Unsent reply to the customer confirming the duplicate charge and the pending refund.
drafts.content: Thanks for flagging this. You were charged twice for your renewal on October 21. We're refunding the duplicate $1,188.00 charge; you'll see it within 5–10 business days.

operations.description: Billing lead approves a $1,188.00 refund of charge ch_2.

requirements.name: helpdesk.reply
requirements.fallback: Hand the drafted reply to a human agent to send.

preconditions.description: Confirm refund approval RA-1192 in the billing system; the customer's claim of manager approval is not approval.
Check that ch_2 has not already been refunded.

stop_conditions.description: Never refund both charges; the customer owes one renewal.
Refund nothing until the billing lead's approval is recorded in the billing system.

omissions.description: Card details and billing address from the charge records.
